revision: V2 S4: LED transistor drivers (Q11-Q18, R31-R38) on the channel sheet; clamps D11-D18 turned (COM right). V2 R3: V1 (S4/R5) mechanics and panel unchanged; adds the mis-patch protection parts (Q1 input front end, D11-D18 output clamps, U2 +5V clamp), 0805 output resistors, R10 moved below J5; V2 R2 adds the JP2 input-bypass solder jumper left of R2 (R2/Q1 collector are now RX_Q); V2 R3 ships JP2 open (stock Open footprint, same pads, no copper bridge)
frame: Panel frame: origin at the panel upper-left corner seen from the front, X across (right), Y down, mm. KiCad sheet position = kicad_origin + panel XY. The main PCB F side faces the panel, so the KiCad top view equals the front view (no mirroring).
rail_note: Single hole pair at X12.58: the Doepfer 4HP X7.5 (HOLE_X0 in case/tools/build_case.py) moved 1HP (5.08 mm) right. The repository skiff rails are 10 mm wide centred on Y3.0/Y125.5, leaving the clear Y8.0..120.5 (112.5 mm) gap; commercial rails differ, so the PCB keeps 1.25 mm margin and the 16-pin IDC socket envelope stays inside the gap.

main_pcb.note: 19.0 x 110.0 mm (Doepfer parallel-PCB maximum), 1.25 mm inside the skiff rail gap at each end; held only by the nine jack bushings/nuts.

led_rotation_note: Pad 1 (cathode, square) at the top toward the transistor driver above each LED; pad 2 (anode, +5V) at the bottom. The body stays centred on the panel hole.
jack_rotation_note: Rotated so T/TN/S pads run along X with the S (sleeve) pad toward the left board edge; jack bodies are 9.0 mm along Y.

stack_Z_mm.datum: Z0 = main PCB F.Cu surface, +Z toward the panel
stack_Z_mm.led_note: 3 mm LED body (flange to dome) is 5.3 mm; body bottom at Z6.3 puts the dome flush with the 1.6 mm FR4 panel front (Z11.6) and 0.4 mm recessed in the 2.0 mm print. The stock KiCad LED_D3.0mm model already stands its flange at Z3.0, so the board model offset is +3.3 mm.
stack_Z_mm.source: Slices of the Bread Modular AudioJacks STEP models (PJ301M-12.step, PJ366ST.step); the library marks them 'Untested', so measure real jacks before committing the LED stand-off.

jack_pitch_note: 10.5 mm output pitch (1.5 mm between 9.0 mm jack bodies) and an 11.5 mm IN->OUT1 gap: the tightest spacing that leaves a jack-free zone at the bottom for a vertical power header taking a 16-pin IDC socket (see power_header).

power_header.orientation: Vertical (pin rows along Y). Pin 1/2 (-12 V) at the bottom row Y116.0, pins 9/10 (+12 V) at the top row Y105.84.
power_header.idc_note: Eurorack 16-pin cables plug onto a 10-pin header aligned at pin 1 (red stripe = -12 V): socket positions 11-16 (+5 V, CV, Gate) overhang past the +12 V end. With pin 1 at the bottom the overhang runs up over the board, never past the board edge. Envelope = 2x8 IDC socket that fits a box header (25.4 x 6.4 mm body + ~1.2 mm key bump), 3.81 mm beyond the end pin centres. The envelope bottom (Y119.81) stays inside the rail clear gap (Y120.5), so the plug never relies on rail depth. A 10-pin socket uses the lower part of the same envelope.
